content: Hassa7issiza Shuchchata Eso
Kawoteththay wuri Yordaanoose shaafaa pinnidaappe guye GODAY Iyaaso,
«Isra7eele asaappe 12 asata doora; issi issi qommofe issi issi as gido.
Histtada isttas, ‹Yordaanoose shaafaa giddon qeeseta tohoy eqqidasoppe 12 shuchchata ekkite; he shuchchata tookki efidi hach intte aqizason woththite› gaada yoota» gides.
Hessa gishshas Iyaasoy Isra7eele qommotappe issi issi as ekkidi tammanne nam7u doorettidayta xeygides.
Histtidi isttas, «GODAA intte Xoossaa Caaqo Qaalaa Taabotay dizasoho Yordaanoose shaafaa gelite; Isra7eele qommota qoodan wurikka issi issi shuch intte hashen hashen tookkite.
Ha shuchchati GODAY hach ooththidayssa inttena hassa7issiza malata gidana; wodeppe intte nayti inttena, ‹Ha shuchchati aazee?› giidi oychchiza wode,

intte, ‹GODAA Caaqo Qaalaa Taabotay pinniza wode Yordaanoose shaafay goggizayssa aggi eqqides; ha shuchchati he sohon hanidayssa ubbaa mernaas Isra7eele asaa hassa7issizayta› giidi isttas yootite» gides.
Isra7eele asay Iyaasoy azazida mala ooththides; GODAY Iyaasos yootida mala Isra7eele qommota qoodan 12 shuchchata Yordaanoose shaafaa giddofe ekkida; tookki ehidi ba aqida sohon woththida.
Iyaasoy Caaqo Qaala Taabotaa tookkida qeeseta tohoy Yordaanoose shaafa giddon eqqidaason 12 shuchchata essides; he shuchchati hach gakkanaas heen deettes.

GODAY Iyaaso azazidayssa ubbaa asay polana gakkanaas Caaqo Qaala Taabotaa tookkida qeeseti Yordaanoose shaafaa giddon eqqi gam7ida; Musey Iyaaso azazida azazoykka hessa; asay eesotidi shaafaa pinnides.
Asay wuri pinnidaappe guye GODAA Caaqo Qaala Taabotaynne qeeseti asay istta xeellishin pinnida.
Musey azazida mala Oroobeele zareti, Gaade zaretinne Minaase zaretappe baggay ola miishshaa oykkidi Isra7eele asaappe sinththatidi pinnida.
Qoodan 40,000 gidiza asay tooranne gondalle oykki olas giigettidi GODAA sinththan Iyarkko matan diza demba pinnida.
He gallas GODAY Iyaaso Isra7eele asaa ubbaa sinththan dhoqqu dhoqqu histtides; asay Muse bonchchida mala Iyaasokka izi dida layth ubbaan bonchchides.
Hessafe guye GODAY Iyaasos,
«Caaqo Qaala Taabotaa tookkida qeeseti Yordaanoose shaafappe kezana mala azaza» gi yootiin,
Iyaasoy qeeseta, «Yordaanoose shaafappe kezite» gi azazides.
GODAA Caaqo Qaala Taabotaa tookkida qeeseti Yordaanoose shaafa giddofe kezidi mela biitta istti yedhdhida mala heerakka Yordaanoose haaththay kase mala shaafaa kumidi gogeth oykkides.
Asay koyro aginan tammanththa gallassan Yordaanoose shaafaa pinnidi Iyarkkon arshey mokkizaso baggara zawatiza Gelgelan dunkaanides.
Iyaasoy Yordaanoose shaafappe ehida 12 shuchchata Gelgelan essides.
Isra7eele asaas, «Wodeppe intte zareti ba aawata, ‹Ha shuchchati aazee?› gi oychchiza wode,
‹Isra7eele asay Yordaanoose shaafaa mela biitta yedhdhidi pinnidayssa hassa7issizayssa› giidi yootite.
Nuni pinnana gakkanaas GODAA nu Xoossay Zo7o abbaa kase nu sinththan melissida mala intteka pinnana gakkanaas GODAA intte Xoossay Yordaanoose shaafaa intte sinththan melissides.
Hessaththo izi ooththiday sa7an diza asay wuri GODAA wolqqay ay mala gitakko eranaassinne intteka GODAAS intte Xoossaas mernaas yayyanaassa» gides.
